claims.text: The Tower of Hanoi puzzle was invented in 1883 by the French mathematician Édouard Lucas.
The Tower of Hanoi was not invented by a Vietnamese scholar, a Chinese engineer or an Indian priest.
Lucas published the puzzle under the name N. Claus de Siam, an anagram of Lucas d'Amiens.
The puzzle was sold with a made-up legend of temple priests moving 64 golden discs.
